description:

Lovely circular walk with some stunning views of the lochs and surroundings between Beinn Dublin and Coire.

Starting in Luss, the trail follows the glen, along Luss water, before turning to the right up a steep climb to Coire aa h-Eanachan. From here, follow the ridge round to Beinn Dubh, before starting a steady descent back to Luss.

trail_name: Inveraray Castle and Dun na Cuaiche Watchtower
description:
Out & back
Starting in Inverary, the trail heads along the road up to the castle where the path up the hill is joined. This path climbs up through the trees and winds to the watchtower and viewpoint.

Here you can enjoy beautiful views over Loch Shira and Loch Fyne as well as over the surrounding mountains. The watchtower is in fact a decorative structure, created in 1748 by Roger Morris and William Adam.

There are a number of places for refreshments in Inverary, as well as points of historic interest, such as the old jail.

Take care on the rougher sections, especially in wetter conditions.
